_doc: Ending credits (edit freely). 'sections' roll in order; each line is [role, name] or [text]. 'sources' lists the asset origins the Special Thanks may name; tests check every thanked name is in this list AND in data/models.json / assets/CREDITS.txt.
title: TOMMYZILLA CITY SMASH

sections.head: CREDITS
lines: Quaternius, Kenney, kazuma (CC0) + primitive shapes by Computer
Procedurally generated tileable textures by Computer (CC0)
Poppins by Indian Type Foundry (SIL Open Font License)
Quaternius (CC0 rigs and clips) + procedural animation by Computer
Procedural audio synthesised in code by Computer
Procedural music synthesised in code by Computer

sections.head: SPECIAL THANKS
lines: A huge, heartfelt thank you to everyone who shares their work for free.
Quaternius - for the Ultimate Monsters (Dino / Tommyzilla, Yeti, Sparkle Dragon,
Blue Demon / THE BULK and the whole monster crew), the Mech Bee and Mech Fox, the SWAT cops, the soldiers,
the tank and the street props. Your monsters gave every kaiju its personality.
kazuma - for the helicopter that buzzes over Victoria.
Kenney - for the city buildings, roads, cars and the mini characters who fill the streets.
Poly Pizza (poly.pizza) and Kenney.nl - for making free CC0 assets easy to find and use.
Thank you for making games like this possible for kids everywhere.
